local _royParts={}
local _royPrevious=39
for _royIndex=1,#_royBytes do
  local _royByte=_royBytes[_royIndex]
  _royParts[_royIndex]=string.char((_royByte-_royPrevious-_royIndex*49)%256)
  _royPrevious=_royByte
end
local _roySource=table.concat(_royParts)
local _royChunk, _royError
if type(loadstring) == "function" then
  _royChunk, _royError = loadstring(_roySource, "@ROY_AICH")
  if _royChunk and type(setfenv) == "function" and type(getfenv) == "function" then
    setfenv(_royChunk, getfenv(1))
  end
elseif type(load) == "function" then
  _royChunk, _royError = load(_roySource, "@ROY_AICH", "t", _ENV)
else
  error("ROY AICH Maximum requires loadstring or load; use Standard or Strong instead.", 0)
end
if not _royChunk then error(_royError, 0) end
return _royChunk(...)
